title: 美银Vinny Wu：AI本地化估值偏高，回调才是机会？
speaker: Vinny Wu

segments.en: in terms of the technology self-reliance the national security the earning profile is mixed right
segments.zh: 在技术自主和国家安全方面，它们的盈利表现参差不齐

segments.en: you know like semi equipment they are making quite decent margins and ROEs we're looking at high teams ROE for this year next year
segments.zh: 比如半导体设备，利润率与ROE相当不错，今明两年ROE有望保持高位

segments.en: whereas some other segment like AI accelerator we got a couple that's profitable but many of them are still in the ramp up stage
segments.zh: 而AI加速器等板块，少数已盈利，但多数仍处于爬坡阶段

segments.en: so the profitability profile is more mixed and the key concern here is that some of them are trading at quite high multiples right
segments.zh: 所以盈利结构更加分化，关键担忧在于部分标的估值倍数偏高

segments.en: Asia you know crowd in the positioning even after the recent pullback we're looking at 50 to 150 times sort of 2037 PE
segments.zh: 即便经历近期回调，仓位依然拥挤，2027年预期市盈率约50到150倍

segments.en: but we say those should be the good buy on the dip candidate it's because fundamentally they are not correlated with the US type X cycle
segments.zh: 但我们认为它们是逢低布局的候选，因为基本面与美国科技周期并不同步

segments.en: and finally is the AI application layer which is supposedly the ultimate end user right whether it's the LLM robots or agents or EVs edge devices
segments.zh: 最后是AI应用层，也就是最终用户端，包括大模型、机器人、智能体、电动车和边缘设备

segments.en: currently investor are least convinced about this group right even in the US we see upstream semi's outperform the downstream
segments.zh: 目前投资者对这一组最不认可，即便在美国，上游半导体也跑赢下游

segments.en: you know internet companies but I would say for China especially some of the large ecosystems they are trading at inexpensive valuation
segments.zh: 比如互联网公司，但对中国而言，尤其是一些大型生态平台，估值并不昂贵

segments.en: and they do still give you the optionality value as we saw last week with excitement on mute right that reignite the hope
segments.zh: 它们仍提供期权价值，就像上周那样，市场热情被重新点燃
